prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which Should You Learn First?
plan.description: A quick take on choosing between React and Vue as your first frontend framework. Learn what each is good for and how to decide fast.

beats.narration: Stuck choosing between React and Vue? Here's the truth: you can't really pick wrong. Both teach you the same core ideas.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.narration: React has a huge job market and ecosystem. Vue is gentler, with clear docs and a smoother start for beginners.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.narration: Want jobs fast? Pick React. Want an easy first win? Pick Vue. Either way, just start building today.
beats.speaker: narrator
